integrity: Exact first-passage mean is explicitly credited to broader prior work; finite checker data is corroboration, not proof. No third-party full text is included.
scientific_limitations: Only a one-dimensional, continuous-time, symmetric unit-per-edge nearest-neighbor walk reset to a fixed site with a single rate-kappa trap is addressed. No claims beyond the quantified parameter range or for stability in modified stochastic models; possible earlier general optimizer theorems require independent priority assessment.
title: Finite reactivity restores a unique optimal reset rate on the one-dimensional lattice
